Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale.
You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.
You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

• Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices.
• Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking.
• Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding.
• Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution.
• Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces.
• Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification.
• Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.
• Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable.
